title: Understanding MSE Minimization
text: To minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE) using a constant model, consider what value of $$\theta_0$$ would make the predicted values closest to the actual $$y$$ values.

title: Mean as a Minimizer
text: Recall that the mean of a set of numbers is the value that minimizes the sum of squared deviations from the numbers. How does this relate to minimizing MSE?

title: Calculating the Mean
text: Calculate the mean of the target outputs $$y_i$$. This mean is the value of $$\theta_0$$ that minimizes the MSE for a constant model.

title: Why the Mean?
text: The mean minimizes the sum of squared differences because it balances the positive and negative deviations from the data points.
